channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Indonesian Rupiah: Policy continuity supports currency – Societe Generale
item.description: Societe Generale analysts Galvin Chia and Kunal Kundu note that Bank Indonesia kept the BI rate at 5.75%, with deposit and lending facility rates unchanged, reinforcing Rupiah stability and inflation control.

item.title: Gold Price Forecast: XAU/USD bounces to $4,370, but upside momentum is fading
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) trades moderately higher on Wednesday and returns to the $4,370 area, after finding buyers near the $4,300 area on Tuesday.

item.title: WTI Price Forecast: Needs decisive break above $85 for fresh advance
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI), futures on NYMEX, trade 0.55% higher at around $84.80 during the European trading session on Wednesday.

item.title: Silver has rebounded to $63, but inflationary risks hold buyers back
item.description: Silver (XAG/USD) stabilizes around $63.45 on Wednesday, up 0.16% on the day at the time of writing. The white metal is attempting to regain its footing after hitting an intraday low of $62.19, initially extending the pullback that followed Tuesday’s rejection from the $66.50 area.

item.title: British Pound: Carry appeal keeps Sterling resilient as BoE stays on hold – ING
item.description: ING’s Chris Turner, citing UK economist James Smith, notes that July United Kingdom (UK) Consumer Price Index (CPI) had limited impact on EUR/GBP, with benign food inflation and only a modest uptick in the Bank of England’s core services measure to 3.8%.

item.title: Gold finds support as US Dollar retreats ahead of Fed Minutes
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) regains ground on Wednesday after falling nearly 2% on the previous day as a softer US Dollar (USD) and a modest pullback in long-term US Treasury yields lend support to the precious metal. At the time of writing, XAU/USD trades around $4,371, up 0.90% on the day.

item.title: US Dollar: Exposure normalizes as real rates fall – BNY
item.description: BNY’s Geoff Yu highlights that international investors are aggressively cutting Dollar exposure as real-yield support erodes following the July FOMC meeting. The bank sees the Dollar decline as a normalization of previously extreme U.S. asset holdings rather than a collapse in U.S. exceptionalism.

item.title: Indian Rupee trades lower, RBI remains on standby to limit downside
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) remains vulnerable against the US Dollar (USD), close to its two-week low at around 95.75.

item.title: Australian Dollar ticks up from intra-week lows with all eyes on Fed minutes
item.description: The Australian Dollar (AUD)has bounced up from intra-week lows against the US Dollar (USD) on Friday, although the daily chart remains negative.

item.title: GBP/USD Price Forecast: More upside expected above 1.3570
item.description: The British Pound (GBP) is up 0.2% to near 1.3557 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Wednesday.

item.title: Australian Dollar: RBA seen sidelined on softer wages – BBH
item.description: Brown Brothers Harriman’s (BBH) Elias Haddad reports the Australian Dollar is underperforming as bond yields fall after Q2 wage growth matched expectations. Haddad argues this outcome will keep the RBA on hold, with private sector wage gains at a four‑year low.

item.title: Euro steadies against Japanese Yen as ECB, BoJ rate-hike bets collide
item.description: EUR/JPY trades around 184.70 on Wednesday at the time of writing, edging 0.03% lower on the day.

item.title: Brazilian Real: Election risks then renewed gains – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank FX analysts Norman Liebke and Michael Pfister see the Brazilian Real (BRL) supported by the Brazilian Central Bank’s (BCB) hawkish stance and still-elevated real interest rates.

item.title: Euro extends gains against British Pound as Eurozone inflation accelerates
item.description: The Euro (EUR) trades higher against the British Pound (GBP) on Wednesday, on track for a five-day winning streak, and received additional support after Eurozone final inflation figures confirmed higher price pressures in July.

item.title: Silver price today: Silver falls, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Silver prices (XAG/USD) fell on Wednesday, according to FXStreet data. Silver trades at $63.10 per troy ounce, down 0.38% from the $63.35 it cost on Tuesday.

item.title: United Kingdom: Upside risks building for inflation – Deutsche Bank
item.description: Deutsche Bank’s Chief United Kingdom (UK) Economist Sanjay Raja notes that UK inflation data for July broadly matched expectations, with headline Consumer Price Index (CPI) rising and core CPI steady.

item.title: Euro remains stronger following July’s Eurozone HICP data
item.description: EUR/USD rises after registering minor losses in the previous day, trading around 1.1600 during the European hours on Wednesday. The pair holds ground as the Euro (EUR) remains stronger following the release of Eurozone Harmonized Index of Consumer Prices (HICP) data for July.

item.title: Copper: LME stock jump eases supply squeeze – ING
item.description: ING’s commodities team highlights that Copper prices on the LME have retreated sharply, falling below $14,000/t as a significant increase in on-warrant inventories eases the previous supply squeeze.

item.title: US Dollar: Higher yields threaten housing and risk sentiment – MUFG
item.description: MUFG’s Derek Halpenny highlights how elevated US Treasury yields and rising mortgage rates are beginning to weigh on the US housing market, with Housing Starts and Pending Home Sales softening.

item.title: Japanese Yen: BoJ’s hawkish pivot reshapes outlook against US Dollar - Standard Chartered
item.description: Standard Chartered strategists have revised its Bank of Japan (BoJ) rate outlook, bringing forward its expected 25bps hike from October to September and raising its terminal rate forecast to 1.75% from 1.50% previously.

item.title: Swiss Franc picks up within range, USDollar softens awaiting Fed minutes
item.description: The Swiss Franc (CHF) appreciates moderately on Wednesday, as the US Dollar (USD) pulls back against major peers, with investors bracing for the release of the minutes of July’s Federal Reserve (Fed) monetary policy meeting, due later on the day.

item.title: Indian Rupee: Range-bound with RBI support against US Dollar – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank FX analysts Charlie Lay and Moses Lim see USD/INR staying broadly stable as the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) keeps the policy repo rate at 5.25% and remains in wait-and-see mode.

item.title: Gold: Pullback risk with higher yields and Oil – OCBC
item.description: OCBC’s Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong note that Gold’s rebound has lost momentum as renewed Oil gains and higher long-end US yields revive inflation concerns. Daily charts show fading bullish momentum and a lower Relative Strength Index (RSI) from near overbought levels.

item.title: Dow Jones futures pause as tech sell-off, oil pressures weigh on sentiment
item.description: Dow Jones futures inch higher 0.06% to trade around 53,440 during European hours on Wednesday. Meanwhile, S&P 500 futures remain steady near 7,710, and Nasdaq 100 futures edge lower 0.03%, trading near 29,580.

item.title: United States Dollar Index slumps in countdown to FOMC minutes
item.description: The US Dollar (USD) trades lower against its major currency peers on Wednesday ahead of the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) minutes of the July policy meeting, which will be published at 18:00 GMT.

item.title: US Dollar: Range-bound trading as FOMC minutes loom – ING
item.description: ING’s Chris Turner notes that the Dollar remains supported by higher energy prices and long-end US yields, but FX volatility is still low, favouring carry trades.

item.title: WTI holds ground around $84.50 as supply risks increase due to US-Iran peace uncertainty
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) oil price moves sideways after three days of gains, trading around $84.50 per barrel during the European hours on Wednesday.

item.title: Euro: Extends rebound as yields stabilize against US Dollar - Danske Bank
item.description: Danske Research Team notes that EUR/USD has extended its rebound towards 1.1600 as European yields remain elevated while US Treasury yields stabilize after the recent spike.

item.title: USD/CAD Price Forecast: Bears look at 1.3850 support after rejection at 1.3900
item.description: The US Dollar (USD) resumes its broader bearish trend with the Canadian Dollar (CAD) drawing support from higher Oil prices and a deal with the US to pause 50% tariffs on Canadian exports.

item.title: British Pound: BoE outlook steady with CPI and jobs data – MUFG
item.description: Derek Halpenny at MUFG notes that UK July CPI came in broadly as expected, with the headline rate rising to 2.9% mainly on higher utility bills, while services inflation eased.
